notes.title: v0.3.0 - The Archer Release
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31068014/09015ae9d28945508fbd9bf154d9383de83c474b.png

It's Patch Day! 

We're really excited to bring you this weeks build. More than just bug fixes, this build is packed with more features which bring us that much closer to a 1.0 release. 

As always, please don't hesitate to reach out to us if you've got any suggestions or bugs which need squashing. 

Happy Rustling,
~Rob, Derrick, and Herb

******************************************************
*** LEADER BOARDS HAVE BEEN RESET ***
******************************************************

New Features
The Archer!
Levels (26 - 35)
Friend Leader board
Dungeon Master Voice-Over
Death Splatters - enemies leave tidbits of themselves behind

New Enemies
The Bat
Weeping Angel
The Golem

Bug Fixes
"Level Stuck" Spawner wasn't spawning
Don't allow running on ladder

Misc Changes
Difficulty increased on levels 15, 17, and 21
Spawn graphics tweaks
Message when player attacks DK from the front - Don't do that!!
Message for when walking over a potion you don't need
Music volume slider in options menu
Endurance potion around the border of the room in level 12
New startup sequence
New Player Portal Art
Notification font matches the rest of the fonts (bye-bye skater font)

notes.title: The Mage Update - v0.2.0
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31068014/8cf9f05b1bb104c8a1e48ca145440b0bc6c6e5f8.png

We're excited to release the second playable class for Dungeon Rustlers: The Mage! 

He's a fire-ball throwing machine who's an absolute wreaking ball once you've got all his abilities and minions upgraded. The downside? He's squishy. With only 2 hit points, you'll find yourself staying far away from enemies instead of rushing in like you did with the knight. 


============================================
===> THE LEADER BOARDS HAVE BEEN RESET <===
============================================


That means you've got a fresh chance at climbing to the number one spot in the ranking for both the Mage AND the Knight!


In addition to adding the Mage, there are more changes in this build to check out. Read the full patch notes below.

Happy Rustling!
~Rob, Derrick, & Herb

Bug Fixes
- Potential fix for crash due to bad video memory management
- Fixed bad end-level portal spawn locations
- Music no longer starts at the beginning of a level if it's been disabled
- Level number  not resetting to level 1 after finishing level 25
- Water bubble was not observing tiering logic

Audio
- New music on level 19 & 20
- Lowered frequency of some Knight voice cues

UI Enhancements
- "your best score" Countdown timer now just pulses level timer (doesn't render big numbers)
- Stats and Leaderboard screens now support viewing different classes
- Changed default cursor to be dagger
- List boxes for scores now have functional buttons and obey keyboard & mouse scroll wheel actions


Misc
- New actors in the credits screen!
- Added additional debug logic for when games get "stuck"
- New enemy portal animation

notes.title: The Slimy Pre-Mage Patch
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31068014/10205688424c5c7767f8adbdbc8cfa8a555ae55e.gif

What's up, rustlers? 
Tonight's patch contains fixes, new features, and a bunch of "under the covers" plumbing to get ready for next weeks big update: The Mage! 

We think you'll find some fun stuff in this patch, including a voice for the Knight, the new "Red Slime" and actually knowing when you get hit (a nice thing to know). 

As always - let us know if you hit a bug, or would like to see something tweaked. 

Happy Rustling!
~Rob, Derrick, & Herb


General
Added "You Died" text during death sequence
Added audio queues for knight
Red Slime is in the house!

Bug Fixes
Dying in acid no longer respawns you in a "taking damage" state
After dying, previously available upgrade was still pulsing
Music was playing even if toggled to off
Level-end portal being rendered on pilar (unreachable) 

Music
Overall volume lowered
Volume can be raised with PageUP and lowered with PageDOWN (slider coming soon)

Camera
Shakes when player takes damage
Now tracks player with a smoother algorithm

Death Knight
Show a target on the ground of where it's going to charge to
Play a sound when charging
Pauses after emerging from portal
